title: Person memory pins, recalls, lists, and forgets only under a grant
summary: Person memory pins a line only after an explicit remember command. Recall, list, and forget run on that diary. The remember consent defaults to deny.
body:
The person-memory module is a per-person diary, a second file, not the truth-card diary. Truth cards are not ingested. Each row keeps who, when, and source. The remember flag follows the consent default, and that default is deny. While deny holds, this type does not open the diary file.

Opened from a flag, the only grant is the trimmed word grant. Any other flag, including an unset flag, stays denied, and the file is not created. The pin command returns the text after an explicit remember request. None means the line is not a pin. A pin whose normalised text is already live is not written again. A pin write while the grant is closed is refused. Recall is a lexical search of that person's rows. It returns no items when the grant is closed. A hit stays only when the speaker is that person and every query token is in the hit text, the speaker, or the source. List returns every live episode and diary row for one person, newest source date first. The module states that this read is not a search. It returns nothing while the grant is closed, and it does not create a missing file. Forget copies the row into the diary archive and drops it from search. The archive is the tombstone. This module has no delete of that table. A forget while the grant is closed is refused. The trait default for a matching forget is recall, then forget each hit.
